sloka: अवेक्षमाणः सस्नेहम् चक्षुषा प्रपिबन्न् इव ।उवाच रामः स्नेहेन ताः प्रजाः स्वाः प्रजाइव ॥२-४५-५॥
transliteration: avekṣamāṇaḥ sasneham cakṣuṣā prapibann iva ।uvāca rāmaḥ snehena tāḥ prajāḥ svāḥ prajāiva ॥2-45-5॥

translations.english: Looking at the people with love as if they were his own children and as though drinking them with his glances, Rama appealed to them:
